% Long URLs in a bibliography, set with hyperref's \url. In the PDF, a URL
% breaks with no hyphen added.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
Some text, as cited in \cite{guide} and \cite{report}.
\begin{thebibliography}{9}
\bibitem{guide} A.~Author. A guide to the documentation.
\url{https://example.org/internationalization/documentation/representations/characterizations}.
\bibitem{report} B.~Writer. A report.
\url{https://example.org/reports/understandingrepresentationsofcharacterization/introduction}.
\end{thebibliography}
\end{document}
